_note: Profiles are presets of independent settings. Ladders run cheapest first; escalation only on a failed objective check. Technical first rungs: tool-free tasks try lean mode (pilot_v2: ~96% fewer tokens per correct, its one miss caught by the check); tool tasks try only their toolset (pilot_toolset_v1: 6/6 vs 6/6 correct, -77% tokens per correct). General/important have no check, so they never start minimal. Hygiene only for hygiene_agents on tool runs (pilot_v2: Codex -36%, Claude +4%).
hygiene_instruction: Keep tool output short: use quiet or summary flags, limit long output with head, tail or grep, and pipe long logs through `python3 {compact}` before reading them. Do not re-read output you have already seen.

technical.lean_system_prompt: You are a precise assistant. Answer the question directly.

_note_retry: A transient API/network error is retried once on the same rung (same model, same files) before the ladder treats it as a failed attempt; otherwise an outage escalates to a pricier model. Claude Code already retries API errors internally before exiting, so one short extra try is enough. The harness's own timeout is never retried.
